szenen.text: Stocks, bonds and crypto are all under pressure. Here are four reasons, in twenty seconds.
One: rates. Markets see an 88 percent chance that the Fed hikes in December.
Two: bonds. The 10 year Treasury yield climbed back above 5 percent. That makes money expensive for everyone.
Three: oil. The US Iran war is in its seventh month, and Brent is near 100 dollars.
Four: ETFs. Nearly 3 billion dollars left the US spot bitcoin ETFs in two weeks. Follow for what comes next.
